Nord Anglia International School Dublin is a truly unique place to learn. We’re the only private school in Dublin, Ireland, accredited to deliver the world-renowned International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum to students aged from 3 to 18. We're also a vibrant global community, where every child is empowered to achieve their goals.
Nord Anglia International School Dublin offers a world-class education in a vibrant international community. With a kaleidoscope of cultures and talent, we learn and grow together each day.
Principal, Nord Anglia International School Dublin

One of the top private schools in Dublin, we inspire our International Baccalaureate (IB) students to learn with purpose and passion. This empowers them to achieve outstanding academic results that open doors to the world’s finest universities. Our broad IB curriculum encourages independence and critical thinking. We take our students beyond the course content, too, offering unique experiences that pique their curiosity, encourage innovation, and instil a lifetime love of learning.

A LEARNING EXPERIENCE DESIGNED FOR THE FUTURE
Created by world-leading experts, our internationally recognised curriculum reimagines education through six key pillars.
We teach the IB curriculum because it delivers the best of both worlds – meaning your child gets the best academic results, while also making friends, having fun and growing their personal interests.

At Nord Anglia International School Dublin, we know that learning isn’t restricted to classrooms. Our students are encouraged to pursue their interests and strengths in every area, be it performing arts, languages, athletics or STEAM (science, technology, engineering, arts and maths), or beyond.

Our Leopardstown campus is a dynamic, vibrant space, where every classroom is equipped with advanced learning technology that brings education to life. In this exciting environment of modern, purpose-built learning spaces, our teachers can unlock every student’s talents, whether in STEAM, music, drama or sport.

Outstanding teachers make outstanding schools. That’s why we select only the most passionate, experienced educators and give them unparalleled professional development opportunities. This ensures our teachers can give 100 per cent when it comes to inspiring the young minds in their care, motivating them to go on to academic and personal success.

The IB philosophy on international mindedness is ever-present in our curriculum as we strive to expand every student’s world-view, and give them unforgettable experiences with the power to shape their roles as future leaders.
When you join our vibrant international community, you become part of the Nord Anglia network of students, parents and alumni, opening a world of opportunities and forging friendships for life.

pages.title: Social Purpose | Nord Anglia International School Dublin
blocks: At Nord Anglia International School Dublin (NAIS Dublin), we embed service learning across all age groups, motivating students to enact change through outreach programmes by fundraising or volunteering for causes they truly care about. Take our Shoebox Appeal, which students enjoy organising every year in support of Team Hope, which delivers gifts to children affected by poverty.
HELPING STUDENTS GROW INTO MATURE, CONSCIOUS ADULTS

We emphasise the importance of community development programmes both in and out of school. Every project is grounded in care, respect and integrity. By enabling students to follow their own individual passions, we empower them to invent the future. Students participate in Model UN, which inspires them to start thinking – and acting – like world changers. We encourage them to share their thoughts on society’s most pressing issues and to be unapologetically ambitious about having a positive impact on the world. And through Creativity, Activity and Service (CAS), a mandatory core subject in the DP, students collaborate and engage with their community in response to an authentic need, developing real-world skills in the process.

Every year a number of our students participate in a trip to the UNICEF headquarters in New York. Here, they report on NAIS Dublin’s progress in addressing the UN’s 17 Sustainable Development Goals as part of Nord Anglia’s annual Global Challenge. The students enjoy workshops, seminars and debates, and may choose to take part in speaking opportunities at the UN’s High-Level Political Forum (HLPF) and attend a thrilling Model UN event.

It’s the adventure of a lifetime. On our immensely popular Citizenship Expedition, students head to Arusha in Tanzania to help build a village school while learning all about the environment and sustainable development. They nurture their independence, develop their burgeoning global mindset, and witness the importance of looking out for one’s community.

Unique to Ireland, the Gaisce award is a challenge to young people from the President of Ireland to dream big and embrace their potential and measure their personal development. Our students who apply for this prestigious award embrace the opportunity to push boundaries, achieve goals and enhance their sense of citizenship through personal and community challenges.

At NAIS Dublin we believe that education has the power to change the world. Here, outstanding teachers and exceptional educational opportunities teach students to make a difference in the world outside the classroom.

pages.title: About Us | Nord Anglia International School Dublin
blocks: Nord Anglia International School (NAIS) Dublin is Ireland’s first and only school offering the IB curriculum from age 3-18. We’re proud to be developing a new generation of curious, wise, ambitious young people who are motivated to succeed, no matter what path they take in life.
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO

Our NAIS Dublin is the only private school in Dublin accredited to deliver the world-renowned IB curriculum in full - from early years to the IB diploma. Our outstanding teachers engage students in the challenging, results-driven programme, cultivating a critical and global mindset.

When you join Nord Anglia International School Dublin, you become part of a vibrant international community of over 60 nationalities! Our parents play a supportive, proactive role in our school, making it a warm, inclusive place where everyone is welcome. There are numerous opportunities for parents to get involved with the school, including the Parent–Teacher Association (PTA), workshops, and social gatherings designed to foster cultural awareness, communication and build a strong network of families. Mums and dads can also meet at various informational workshops run by school leaders, teachers and specialists, at coffee mornings, and at our very own Parents’ Café, The Chatterbox!

Our private school in Dublin opened its doors to our founding families in September 2018, with our IB accreditation following soon after. In June 2022, we celebrated our first ever graduating cohort and their outstanding IBDP results!

“Our two boys love the Nord Anglia International School Dublin community! They quickly made firm friends when we first moved here, and both love the different aspects of the IB programme that suit their varied interests. Our elder son loves design, as it combines aspects of mathematics, planning, analytics and creativity in a unique programme which always challenges and interests him. Our younger son most enjoys the varied sports and games offered at the school. As a family, we cherish the NAIS Dublin community, and know we’ve made friendships for life!”
“I love how open to change our school is – it always feels like student and staff input is taken into account when decisions are made.”

“Our rigorous and well-rounded curriculum propels students into the greatest expression of their potential, forging confident, thoughtful and creative individuals fuelled by a love for learning and a hunger to transform the world.”
“Our school is about so much more than learning. We are a loving community, we support each other, and we have fun together like one big family.”
